definition: a person who holds a position of authority
description: At a mountain border crossing a man in a light blue uniform with rank stars on his shoulders and white gloves opens a passport and studies the photo page. At a metal table he shines a small torch into an open suitcase and lifts out the folded clothes one by one. He then walks along the side of a camper van with a gloved hand on the bodywork, lies flat on the road to shine his torch underneath it, and slides back out beside a clipboard while a second man in the same uniform works behind him.

en.question: What is the officer lying under?

es.answer: Está tumbado debajo de una furgoneta.
phrases: estar tumbado debajo de una furgoneta
es.question: ¿Debajo de qué está tumbado el agente?

fr.answer: Il est allongé sous une camionnette.
fr.question: Sous quoi l'agent est-il allongé ?
